The '''Council of Galactic Rights''' was a committee in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] that existed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], addressed the council shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] condemning [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[humanocentrism]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] policies.
